protocols.description: Emigration Brewing Co.'s guide for personal agents: tell it what the user wants to do or know on emigrationbrewing.com and it answers with where to go on the site. It can't sign in, buy, book or submit forms.

apis.description: Emigration Brewing Co.'s website search for personal agents, as a read-only MCP server: call search_site with what the user wants to do or know on emigrationbrewing.com and it returns the matching pages' titles, URLs and short descriptions from the site's own search. It can't sign in, buy, book or submit forms.
